notes: The New Generation stand mixer service manual lists KP26M1X (and 4KP26M1X) among the models it covers, but its parts list does not say which serial range each part number fits. It says units before serial WL46 have a 53-tooth worm gear and an 8-tooth motor, later units a 60-tooth gear and a 10-tooth motor, and that the two sets are not interchangeable.

gaps: The manual gives the motor only as '120V Motor' (part W10247536) and does not name its type, so motor_universal is the nearest template type. Earlier Johnson motors (9703672, 9706251, 9706548) and the FHP motor 9703585 are for other serial ranges and are not claimed here.
No watt or horsepower rating is given for the motor, so no w is set.
No triac or phase control part is named for this design; the control board is shown as DAC control. No thyristor claim is made.
The parts list gives control assembly 9706648 (with black knob) as well as control board 9706509. The manual does not say they are the same part, so only 9706509 is claimed.

The fault table says the motor shuts off when overheated or overloaded but names no part, so no thermostat is claimed. It gives the reset as 15 seconds off on page 39 and 15 minutes off on page 40 for an overload from too high a speed.
The fault table lists a 'Filter(230V)' with no part number; it is not claimed.
Bearings W10170081 (rear) and W10170080 (front) are listed with no description of which shaft they serve, so they are not called motor bearings.
The partstown.com file name says Professional Heavy Duty, but the document title is the New Generation Stand Mixer Service Manual, 4176981; the title is used here.
method: KitchenAid New Generation Stand Mixer Service Manual, 4176981 (KitchenAid, 2016, 42 PDF pages), hosted on partstown.com. Read as text with the research tool; page numbers are PDF pages (cover is 1). The cover and page 2 list KP26M1X among the covered models.

Control board 9706509 and housing 8212396 on page 4; the case and gearing parts list on page 14 (two-column table, rendered and read column by column); gear 9706590 on page 20; the WL46 note on page 31; the speed switch fault on page 40.
Found through a web search. No other copy of the manual was opened.

comps.spec: Motor, KitchenAid part W10247536, listed in the case and gearing parts list as a 120 V motor.
New control board, part 9706509. The manual says it fits older units if the power cord is changed to W10325656.
Speed slide switch, part of the control board. For a speed control that sticks or binds, the manual's repair is a new control board.
Transmission housing. Where it is plastic, the manual recommends replacing it with a magnesium housing and gasket, part 8212396.
First-stage gear assembly, 60 tooth, part 9706590 (serial WL46 and later).
Planetary assembly (part number by colour on the manual's colour-variation page). The parts list also gives the pinion gear, 9707627, and the agitator shaft, 9708191, as separate parts.
Bevel gear, part 9703337, and attachment hub gear, part 9703338 (parts list).
Bearings listed in the case and gearing parts list: rear W10170081 and front W10170080.
Power cords: white, W10164887, and black, W10325656 (parts list).
